intro.text: A scholar and artist of the Era of Solitude who studied how coloured light affects art and perception.

items.text: Eleseth painted by the light of spheres of a single colour. At first she used too little of that colour in her paintings, but in time her mind compensated. If she changed the colour mid-session, she went on painting for a while as though the old light remained.
Shallan read about Eleseth's work and described it to Pattern; it made her wonder whether she would ever see the world clearly.
